title: A Discrete Radon Transform Based on the Area of Cube-Plane Intersection
summary: The Radon transform is a fundamental tool for analyzing data in tomographic imaging, optimal transport, crystallography, and geometric analysis. Numerical computations require an accurate discretization. To deal with voxelized images and objects, we derive a closed-form, piecewise polynomial expression for the Radon transform of an axis-aligned cube in arbitrary dimension $d$. Building on this formula, we propose a discrete Radon transform in $\mathbb{R}^d$ that is both analytically exact for voxelized data and computationally efficient.
